paragraphs: Model Tile LLC is a bathroom remodeler in Everett, WA that does one thing very carefully: tile. Roman builds walk-in showers in large marble-look porcelain, sets backsplashes and floors, and repairs tile jobs homeowners inherit with a house. The Instagram page lists eleven years of experience.

Reviewers notice the layout. One describes a herringbone marble backsplash centered on the window with a corner that was book-matched, still looking brand new about six years later. Another came back for a second job and says he learned what to look for in tile work where water is involved. Customers call the pricing reasonable and the work prompt.

about.text: Model Tile LLC is an Everett tile company run by Roman, the installer reviewers name when they describe their showers and backsplashes. The business is based on 29th Ave SE in Everett and its Instagram bio lists eleven years of experience. Roman's work leans clean and precise: large marble-look porcelain set with straight lines, niches framed in slim trim, and herringbone laid out from the center of the wall. Customers say he is professional, easy to work with, and willing to explain what good tile work looks like where water is involved.

process.h2: How a tile project with Model Tile works

steps.title: Call or text
steps.text: Call or text (425) 772-1918, or email photos of the space so Roman can see what you have now.

steps.title: Look at the space
steps.text: Roman checks the existing tile, the walls and any water problems, and explains what he sees and why it matters.

steps.title: Plan the layout
steps.text: Tile size, pattern, niches and where the lines fall, such as centering a backsplash on the window, are agreed before setting starts.

steps.title: Tile and finish
steps.text: The tile is set, grouted and trimmed with clean edges around niches and corners. Customers say the work is finished promptly.

steps.title: Walk through it
steps.text: Look over the finished shower, floor or backsplash together and ask anything you want to know about caring for it.

faq.h2: Questions about tile and bathroom work

items.q: Can you fix a tile job someone else did?
items.a: Yes. One repeat customer hired Model Tile to repair and improve a shower tile job he inherited with his home. He says the shower is now more attractive and more functional, and that he learned what to look for in tile work where water is involved.

items.q: Do you do backsplashes as well as bathrooms?
items.a: Yes. Along with showers and bathroom floors, Model Tile installs kitchen backsplashes. One Everett backsplash in herringbone marble was centered on the window with a book-matched corner. Floors in other rooms, like a remodeled family room, are part of the work too.

items.q: How do I get in touch?
items.a: Call or text (425) 772-1918, which is how the Instagram bio asks people to reach out, or email modeltilellc@gmail.com. Sending a few photos of the space and rough measurements helps Roman understand the job before you talk, so the first conversation can be about your options.

Model Tile LLC is at 11608 29th Ave SE, Everett, WA 98208. Its profiles name Everett as the area it works in. If you are outside Everett, call or text with your address and ask whether your project is in range.

items.q: How long have you been doing tile?
items.a: The Model Tile Instagram bio lists eleven years of experience. Reviewers back that up with work that holds up: one backsplash installed about six years ago still looks brand new, according to the family who has lived with it since.
